svg.title: Bird species identification: WingCLIP-0.3 against BioCLIP and CLIP models
svg.desc: Top-1 accuracy on NABirds, all 48,527 images against 11,167 labels: WingCLIP-0.3 86.84%, BioCLIP 2.5 90.31%, BioCLIP-2 86.31%, CLIP ViT-L/14 32.50%, SigLIP B/16 26.75%, CLIP ViT-B/16 25.59%
